data.name: Arlinda
data.gender_notes: Arlinda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arlinda is derived from the Old German name 'Aralindis', which means 'exalted, noble woman'. It is composed of the elements 'ar' meaning 'exalted, noble' and 'lind' meaning 'soft, tender'. The name was popular during the Middle Ages and was borne by several saints. The name Arlinda carries the meaning “Exalted or noble woman” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Arlinda usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted or noble woman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Arlinda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted or noble woman.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arlinda total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: ארלינדה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ארלינדה הוא שם המשלב את המילה 'אל' שפירושה 'אלוהים' או 'אלוהות', עם השם לינדה, שמקורו בספרדית ופירושו 'יפה' או 'תכשיט'. השם ארלינדה משמש לעתים קרובות בקהילות נוצריות, ומבטא את הקשר בין האלוהים והאדם.

in_greek.name: Αρλίνδα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αρλίνδα είναι σύνθεση του ελληνικού 'Αρ' που σημαίνει 'άλλος' ή 'αλλαγή', και του ονόματος Λίντα, που προέρχεται από την ισπανική και σημαίνει 'ωραία' ή 'κοσμήματα'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Αρλίνδα συμβολίζει τη σχέση μεταξύ Θεού και ανθρώπου.

in_latin.name: Arlinda
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Arlinda componitur ex voce 'Ar' quae 'alter' vel 'mutatio' significat, et nomine Linnda, quod ex Hispanicis originem habet et 'pulchra' vel 'jewels' interpretatur. In traditione christiana, nomen Arlinda devotionem Dei et hominis exprimit.

in_english.name: Arlinda
in_english.meaning: Arlinda means noble or divine beauty
in_english.long_meaning: The name Arlinda is a combination of 'Ar' which signifies 'noble' or 'other', and Linda, derived from Spanish meaning 'beauty' or 'jewel'. Etymologically, it relates to Hebrew and Greek roots signifying divine or noble connections. Historically, Arlinda has been used in Christian traditions to denote a person of spiritual beauty or a gift from God. The name carries connotations of nobility, divine favor, and inner beauty.

As a Christian name, it serves as a reminder to embody the virtues of compassion, strength, and dignity in daily life.
